comment: The run flow (F1 D-071/D-072; F3 climb). 'saveFormat' is the 405 run's payload format: a slot that holds it is a 405 run, which this build no longer plays (WP-21, D-1300); it is kept, never loaded (Core2RunLoadStatus.OtherRuleset), and a Core 2 run saves format 3. 'creation' is the W-04 default character: the preselected class, the default tint that picks its portrait, the portrait registry-id template ({class}, {tint}), the journey recorded in the slot summary and the string key of the default character name. 'firstFight' names one encounter deterministically (the encounters of 'seat' in 'pool', in authoring order, at 'ordinal'). 'autosave' says what happens after each committed combat command: 'append' writes it to the slot's command log (PF-06), 'checkpoint' writes a full checkpoint, 'none' writes nothing; 'checkpointOn' lists the command types that also write a full checkpoint (the PF-06 commit point 'combat turn end'). 'newRun.ruleset' is the ruleset a New Game starts (RunHost.Start): 'core2' (Core2RunSession, owner ruling D-164, D-313) is the only one since WP-21. 'newRun.opening' says a New Game plays the opening (W-05, ui/prologue.json; the player's settings.playPrologue can turn it off) before the climb's first step; the run itself stays headless, so bots and tests never see it (VP-12, D-1004). 'settings' names the profile settings the loop reads and their defaults when neither the profile nor the preset's playerSettings sets them (settingOn: shrineMultiUse, shopSell; the hold dial: holdConfirm over balance.ui.holdConfirm). 'core2Screens' routes each place a Core 2 run stands at (Core2RunSession.Location) to the screen that shows it: the fight, the spoils door, the rest site, the shop, the event, the act map and the run end; a screen that is planned or unregistered falls back to the act map.
